resources.title: Flow Design Planning Worksheet
resources.description: A fill-in worksheet for planning a flow's trigger, before/after-save choice, entry conditions, elements, decision logic, and fault-path destination before opening Flow Builder -- pre-filled with Lesson 29's lead-assignment lab as a worked reference, plus the naming convention and before/after-save decision rule.

resources.title: Flow Testing & Debugging Checklist
resources.description: Pre-activation and production-troubleshooting checklists covering Debug, 'Run automation as another user,' saved Flow Tests, and the Flow Error Email Recipient setting -- grounded in Lesson 21's real worked bug (a silent format mismatch between a Lead's State field and a territory lookup field that produced a wrong result with no error at all).

resources.title: Flow Governor Limits Quick Reference
resources.description: A quick-reference card of the SOQL/DML/callout limits Flow shares with Apex, the before/after bulkification pattern that keeps a flow under them regardless of batch size, and a pre-activation self-check for any flow containing a loop.
